evidence: Cic. de Or. 1.261: versūs multōs ūnō spīritū prōnūntiāre (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Also to announce and to deliver a speech or a verdict; the way one says a word is prōnūntiātiō (Quintilian).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 31, checked against the searchable text of the book.

phrases.english: to pronounce a vowel short or long
